findings.summary: The site remains light-only when the user requests a dark color scheme.
findings.evidence: The dark-mode screenshot is visually identical to the light capture; the computed root color-scheme is normal and the body remains rgb(255,255,255).
findings.suggestedFix: Declare light/dark support at the root and replace fixed surface/text colors with adaptive tokens using color-scheme and light-dark() or a prefers-color-scheme fallback.

findings.summary: Low-contrast text does not provide a robust contrast/high-contrast experience.
findings.evidence: axe reported 76 serious color-contrast failures, including red popularity counts; no forced-colors or prefers-contrast adaptation appears in the captured CSS.
findings.suggestedFix: Use WCAG-compliant foreground/background tokens and add forced-colors-safe system-color overrides where custom colors carry meaning.

findings.summary: The primary content journey fails in a fresh mobile session.
findings.evidence: Following a real homepage story link reaches a desktop-scaled cookie-error page instead of the article. Direct listing and search URLs fail similarly; the error asks users to retry or change browser settings.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the cookie-dependent redirect gate from public reading, listing and search routes. Preserve destination state server-side and provide a direct, retryable mobile error path when setup fails.

findings.summary: Navigation changes are abrupt and provide no continuity cue.
findings.evidence: The DOM/CSS probe found no authored View Transition setup; navigation swaps directly from the feed to an unrelated full-page error surface.
findings.suggestedFix: After fixing navigation, progressively enhance same-origin route changes with View Transitions and directional continuity, while respecting reduced motion.

findings.summary: Responsiveness depends on a separate mobile host rather than reusable container-aware components.
findings.evidence: The CSS probe found no container queries; direct list/search routes render a 1000px desktop layout scaled into a 390px viewport, and sitemap lacks a viewport meta tag.
findings.suggestedFix: Unify templates around intrinsic, container-aware components and ensure every route has a correct viewport declaration instead of switching to desktop layouts.

findings.summary: The page disables zoom and many interactive targets are too short for reliable touch use.
findings.evidence: The viewport fixes maximum-scale=1 and user-scalable=no. The interaction probe found many linked rows only 16px high and footer links 12px high; axe flags the viewport restriction as critical.
findings.suggestedFix: Allow user scaling and provide at least 44 CSS px target areas (or equivalent spacing) without shrinking visible text.

findings.summary: The initial content paint is slow despite a light main thread.
findings.evidence: The CDP trace measured FCP 4.25s and LCP 4.29s; Lighthouse measured LCP 3.2s and Speed Index 6.1s. CLS was 0 and TBT was low.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce document latency and prioritize the actual LCP content; defer non-critical requests and avoid waiting on the cookie/device setup path before painting.

findings.summary: Uncompressed, uncached, parser-blocking legacy assets delay delivery.
findings.evidence: HAR found parser-inserted jQuery 1.11.1 (96KB), common JS and CSS without compression; three scripts lack useful cache headers. Lighthouse estimated 64KiB unused JS and 26KiB unused CSS.
findings.suggestedFix: Compress text assets, set immutable caching on versioned files, remove unused code and jQuery 1.11.1 where possible, and defer scripts not required for first paint.

findings.summary: Core controls, links, frames and all images lack required accessible names or alternatives.
findings.evidence: axe found 54 image-alt failures, unlabeled text input/select, two unnamed image links and two untitled frames. The images primitive independently counted 54/54 images without alt.
findings.suggestedFix: Add meaningful alt text (or empty alt for decoration), programmatic labels for search controls, accessible names for icon links, and titles for frames.

findings.summary: The page has no heading/landmark hierarchy and uses invalid list semantics.
findings.evidence: The probe found zero headings and zero semantic landmarks. axe reported malformed dl/ul/li structures across dozens of nodes; focus visibility itself used the browser outline.
findings.suggestedFix: Introduce header/nav/main/footer landmarks, a logical h1-h2 hierarchy, and valid list/definition-list markup while preserving source/focus order.

findings.summary: Document and image asset hygiene is inconsistent.
findings.evidence: axe reports invalid list structures; 17 images lack dimensions and 18 use legacy formats. Lighthouse additionally reports quirks-mode/no doctype for its navigation, while the direct DOM probe observed an HTML doctype, indicating route-dependent document inconsistency.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve a consistent standards-mode document on every route, repair invalid structures, reserve image space, and modernize image delivery.

findings.summary: Some navigation is not crawlable and public indexing signals are incomplete.
findings.evidence: Two visible links use javascript:void(0); Lighthouse fails crawlable anchors. /sitemap.xml returns 404, while robots.txt explicitly blocks major AI/search-agent crawlers.
findings.suggestedFix: Use real href destinations for all navigational controls and publish a current XML sitemap for public content. Keep bot exclusions only where they are an intentional policy.

findings.summary: HTTPS is present, but baseline security headers and cookie protections are missing.
findings.evidence: The headers primitive found no CSP, HSTS, nosniff, clickjacking, Referrer-Policy or Permissions-Policy. Eight cookies were flagged insecure and all eight use SameSite=None; several device cookies lack Secure.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a restrictive CSP, HSTS, nosniff, frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy. Mark HTTPS cookies Secure and use Lax/Strict unless cross-site use is essential.

findings.summary: Public routes depend on fragile cookie/device state and do not degrade to content.
findings.evidence: Fresh-profile article, board, sitemap and search captures fell into cookie-required desktop pages; the article error itself asks users to disable data saver/content blocking or clear all cookies.
findings.suggestedFix: Make route rendering independent of client cookie setup, progressively enhance device preferences, and retain a functional server-rendered content fallback.

findings.summary: Image and legacy script delivery wastes bytes for a text-led mobile feed.
findings.evidence: The images audit found no modern-format images, 18 legacy-format assets, 21 below-fold images without lazy loading and 17 missing dimensions. HAR transferred 411KB, including 96KB jQuery and 187KB images.
findings.suggestedFix: Use modern responsive image formats, lazy-load below-fold assets, reserve dimensions, and remove unnecessary legacy script payload.

taskList.title: Make public article, listing and search routes work without fragile cookie/device state
Restore accessible names, semantics, contrast, zoom and touch targets
Add baseline security headers and harden cookie attributes
Modernize and optimize delivery of scripts, CSS and images
Unify responsive templates and restore crawlable navigation/indexing signals
Respect dark/contrast preferences and add progressive route continuity
